commenti.body: I made a feature film last year and just wrapped filming my second. I hope that  one day I can see them discussed without me having to plug them on social media.

Not film exactly, but I've been diving into the old 60s TV show, The Prisoner. I'm enthralled by every aspect of it: the show, the production, the actors, the social impact, the books written about it afterwards.

The show is more relevant now than it was 50 years ago. And i find Patrick Mcgoohan's stubborn artistic integrity unbelievably refreshing.

in the spirit of the peach scene in 'call me by your name' and the bathtub scene of 'saltburn', what are some other good examples of "devotional defiling" as displayed in these contexts?? another that comes to mind is the mushroom concept in 'phantom thread'. just trying to find more to watch that uses these themes.
